description:
WRITE: updates a site — the fields plan tasks of change.type "config" ask for (their change.content is this tool's input): checkout_url, checkout_steps, checkout_pages, test_account { login_url, email, password } (stored encrypted; the response echoes it without the password), name (the merchant name in generated legal copy), platform, jurisdictions, monitoring_interval_minutes, protection_level.
The response is the site; check checkout.url / checkout.test_account to confirm. Then verify_task the task that asked for it.

checkout_steps.description: Steps to reach the purchase button (clicks / fills), as in the API.

checkout_url.description: Page with the Subscribe / Buy button.

name.description: Merchant / brand name (used in generated disclosures).

protection_level.description: Which tiers the plan lists: minimum (required only), balanced (default: + recommended suggestions), maximum (+ extras). Ask the human before changing it.

site.description: Site id (site_…). Optional when the account has exactly one site in this mode; list_sites shows them.

test_account.description: A TEST subscriber account the scanner logs in with to try cancelling online (echoed back without the password).

reactivate_url.description: Test-only page that re-subscribes the test account.

name: update_site
title: Update a site's settings (write)
